dialogues.speaker: Aradanish
dialogues.text: Aradanish wants, Nara finds. Because Nara is smart and will guess right, but must be fast.

dialogues.speaker: Aradanish
dialogues.text: This time, Aradanish wants... <color=#00E1FFFF>rocks, piles of rocks</color>! Golden Nara will find for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Aradanish
dialogues.text: No, no, Aradanish doesn't want that. Think again, Nara.

dialogues.speaker: Aradanish
dialogues.text: Aradanish will always be here. Come back anytime Nara wants to play a game.

dialogues.speaker: Aradanish
dialogues.text: Golden Nara is as fast as they said!

dialogues.speaker: Aradanish
dialogues.text: Only good Nara plays games with Aradanish. This is for Nara Friend!

dialogues.speaker: Aradanish
dialogues.text: Aradanish found! Play with me, Golden Nara?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't have the time right now.

dialogues.speaker: Aradanish
dialogues.text: Aradanish will wait, until Nara does.
